_what: RECREF watchlist (2026-11-03, research only). Each series was chosen by rule: it had open markets closing within 7 days on 2026-11-03 (found by listing every open non-multivariate market, 38,808 of them), it settles on a public number, and that number's source can be read keyless from a GitHub runner. The script names no ticker; adding a series is an edit here.

series.rule_source: Tomatometer score of the film's Rotten Tomatoes page at 10:00 AM ET on the close day; threshold markets above N. Closes in under 7 days.
Metascore of the game's Metacritic page seven days after release at 10:00 AM ET; threshold markets.
Number of Donald Trump Truth Social posts on one calendar day (ET); count brackets. Reference: Polymarket xtracker posts for the 24 hours before the close.
Which song is #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 for the chart dated the coming Saturday. Billboard's current chart is the last week; kworb's Spotify US weekly and daily lists are the in-week streams.
Which song is #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 for the coming chart.
Rank bucket (for example No. 7 to 10) of one song on the coming Billboard Hot 100.
Which album is #1 on the Billboard 200 for the coming chart. Billboard's current chart is the last week; there is no keyless in-week album source.
Which album is #2 on the Billboard 200 for the coming chart.
Rank on Steam's USA Weekly Top Sellers (top 100 by revenue) for the week. The reference is the store's current top sellers list, a proxy, not the same list.

_not_included: Open on 2026-11-03 but no keyless reference found: KXYTVIEWSW (YouTube Charts artist daily views, 244 markets), KXYTTOPSONGW and KXYTTOPSONGGW (YouTube Charts weekly top songs), KXALBUMSTREAMS (album streams in a tracking week), the Carbon Arc index series (KXSTREAMARRAY, KXSTREAMINGADS, KXCARTAPP). Spotify daily and weekly chart series (KXSPOTIFYD and the others), App Store rank (KXAPPRANK*), Netflix, and weekly post-count series (KXPOTUSTWEETS, KXELONTWEETS) had no open market on 2026-11-03; add them here when they list.
